evidenceClasses.bounded-outcome-observation: Cit+ observed or not observed under a bounded protocol, never an impossibility proof.
evidenceClasses.explicit-non-claim: A boundary preventing genotype, impossibility, original-history, causality, universal-law, or Historical Load promotion.
evidenceClasses.published-generation-sample: A source-generation label without promotion to complete genotype or unique clone.
evidenceClasses.published-history-contingency-interpreta: A paper-attributed bounded interpretation of later-background propensity.
evidenceClasses.published-monte-carlo-summary: A Table 2 statistic retained with its published P value and without a new P-value computation.
evidenceClasses.published-protocol: One exact replay design whose units and scale are not pooled with another design.
evidenceClasses.published-target-phenotype: The selected paper's Cit+ target outcome.
evidenceClasses.source-attribution: A declared separation between article metadata, source tables, protocol descriptions, published interpretation, and Onto2D analysis.
evidenceClasses.table-1-cell: One retained non-missing generation-by-protocol cell from Table 1.
evidenceClasses.visible-arithmetic-discrepancy: A source statistic and a simpler table-derived diagnostic shown together without silent correction.

boundary.note: Non-observation is not impossibility; generation is not genotype; replay is not original history; published statistics are not recomputed; Historical Load remains undefined.
boundary.summary: A replay cell describes observed accessibility from one recorded generation under one exact protocol.
boundary.title: Historical background / replay / interpretation boundary
